notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 66-68) prints only the Associate of Arts Degree (AA) for Media Arts: Virtual Production, Motion Capture, and Advanced Visual Effects (State Code 44391). It does not print a Certificate of Achievement for this title. The certificates it shows are Cinematography, Core Studies, Directing, Editing and Color Grading, Producing, Screenwriting and Sound Design.

The text is cut off mid-sentence in the Sound Design certificate on page 68. The Virtual Production certificate section probably appears on a later page that was not supplied. A reviewer should fetch the following page(s).

For reference, the AA section has the following requirements. Eight required courses: CINEMA 105, CINEMA 107, MEDIART 100, MEDIART 104, MEDIART 107, MEDIART 108, MEDIART 105 and MEDIART 116, at 3 units each. Students also choose 1 of CINEMA 101 or MEDIART 101. The AA prints Major Units: 27 and Total Minimum Units: 60.
These AA requirements and the AA's Program Student Learning Outcomes were not recorded for the certificate, because they belong to a different award.

The closed list has 8 courses at 3 units each, 24 units in all, which falls within the award's 16 to fewer than 30 unit range. That suggests the certificate is a subset of the AA requirements, but the text does not confirm this.
